correctness.rationale: For a finite nonempty agent family of S5 equivalences, meet preservation of S=union_a K_a forces S(intersection all local information classes) to contain w, hence one agent class is their intersection; conversely this implies S equals K_intersection for ALL valuations/nesting. For two agents this is exactly nested intersection of any overlapping partition blocks. Every join-component has both partitions common-indiscrete (one configuration), or exactly one indiscrete and other nontrivial (2*(Bell_m-1)), giving c_m=2Bell_m-1. Distinguished-component recurrence and exponential formula give a1..a7=1,4,19,111,774,6229,56529; independent integer recurrence check confirms these values. Crossing blocks on three worlds refute normality; <=2 worlds cannot cross. Infinite-world validity requires finite A, as explicitly assumed.

Neither accessible theorem-level coverage yields the per-frame filter-collapse equivalence together with the ordered labeled-frame exponential census. Enumerating partition join-components is a natural combinatorial specialisation; under a different partition-nesting terminology, an unindexed equivalent enumeration may exist.
